subject: Advocate enablement: procurement & security gating items (post-demo)
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@finexcap.com>; Raj Patel <raj.patel@finexcap.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Advocate enablement: procurement & security gating items (post-demo)

Hi Alyssa / Raj —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and the concrete asks you flagged so your internal procurement and security teams have what they need to move the pilot forward. I9ve split these into two tracks (procurement / security) and added recommended collateral we can supply.

Procurement (owner: Raj)
- Pricing model: you asked for a 3-month pilot commitment with a usage cap and defined overage rate. I9ll draft an MPA with a pilot appendix and send to legal. (Owner: Dylan) — ETA: 3/15.
- PO/Invoice flow: Finex prefers monthly POs. We can support monthly invoicing or a net-30 contract depending on procurement. Please confirm preferred payment terms.

Security & Compliance (owner: Alyssa)
- Data residency: Finex usage will be US-only. We9re happy to document VPC options and KMS integration.
- Evidence pack: Finex security asked for SOC 2 scope, network diagrams, and an encryption-at-rest statement. Attaching a starter checklist. (See attachment: security-evidence-checklist.xlsx)
- Penetration test schedule: If your team requires an attestation window, we can provide last pentest report and SLA for remediation items.

Champion enablement (owner: Alyssa)
- Internal one-pager for executive sponsor that frames pilot ROI: I9ve attached a short demo summary you can forward to the exec team. (attachment: finex-demo-summary.pdf)
- Suggested talk tracks: cost-per-inference savings, predictable latency SLO, and the "fallback" option that keeps production stable while experimenting with quantized models.

Next steps 
1) I9ll share the draft pilot MPA + pricing appendix by 3/15.
2) Lauren will assemble the security evidence pack and follow up with the SOC 2 scope addendum by 3/14.
3) Alyssa to confirm preferred payment terms and procurement path (PO vs. contract) by 3/17.

If helpful, we can do a short internal enablement call (15-20 minutes) with your security and procurement folks to walk the artifacts and answer questions.

Thanks — looking forward to the pilot.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com]

Attachments:
- finex-demo-summary.pdf (1 page summary, key metrics)
- security-evidence-checklist.xlsx (starter list of docs + owners)
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@finexcap.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@finexcap.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 17:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Advocate enablement: procurement & security gating items (post-demo)

Thanks Dylan — this is exactly what we needed. A few clarifications from my side after syncing with our security lead: 

- SOC 2: We only need the Type II report summary and the list of controls in scope. If you can provide the attestation letter and the auditor name, that9ll speed things up.
- Encryption: Confirm AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.2+ in transit.
- VPC peering: We9re evaluating three vendors for the pilot; can you confirm whether VPC peering or private link is supported in your dedicated offering?

On procurement: Raj prefers a short MPA with a pilot appendix and then a PO against that agreement. Net-30 is fine.

Yes, please send the MPA draft and Lauren9s evidence pack. We9ll aim to get procurement and security responses back in two weeks.

One more ask: I9m going to be the internal advocate; would appreciate a two-slide exec memo we can use to summarize impact in the 3/20 steering committee. Can you pull that together?

—Alyssa
Alyssa Chen
Head of Data Engineering | Finex Capital
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@finexcap.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Mar 2028 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Advocate enablement: procurement & security gating items (post-demo)

Hi all — looping in Ben (SE) and adding the specific artifacts we9ll provide so Alyssa has the two-slide memo and security pack for the 3/20 steering committee.

Artifacts we will deliver by 3/14:
- Two-slide exec memo (owner: Dylan): summary of expected 30/90-day metrics (latency, cost savings %, risk mitigations) + ask for pilot approval.
- Security evidence pack (owner: Lauren): SOC 2 Type II summary, control mapping, network diagram, encryption statements.
- Technical checklist (owner: Ben): inbound/outbound ports, auth pattern, KMS integration notes, sample deployment json.
- Pilot MPA draft (owner: Dylan): covers scope, term, pricing appendix, termination/ownership of logs.

Ben — could you confirm whether we can support VPC peering for this pilot (Finex9s request) or whether we should propose private link? If VPC peering is possible, please call out any known constraints (regions, cloud provider).

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@finexcap.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Mar 2028 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Advocate enablement: procurement & security gating items (post-demo)

Quick update: we support both VPC peering and Private Link in our US region. For the pilot I recommend Private Link for the cleanest network isolation and to avoid cross-account route tables — fewer hoops for procurement. Noted constraints:
- Private Link setup typically needs 2 business days and a connection note for our infra team.
- If Finex wants to test in multiple cloud regions, peering requires a multi-region configuration; Private Link is single-region per endpoint.

I9ll assemble the network diagram and a one-page checklist and add it to the shared Drive folder (link in the thread).

Ben
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: security-evidence-checklist.xlsx
